Latest required terminal confirmed writes define latency, exclude earlier/opening/decision writes and unrelated late receipts. Negative original time invalid, reconciliation-only upper bound. Supersession precedence retained.

No floatactualdollars/price math.
Use verify_evaluation_artifacts(root) seam from correction-contract (core concurrent); do not trust raw summary.json. Test through injected verifier then integrated helper if unavailable report dependency. Include evaluation hashes in report_id; reject/dedupe duplicate/conflicting evaluationidentities; partial/failed not qualityscore; include all zero categories and explicit denominators, usefulness/disagreement/validation/omissions vs humanescapes separate. Reader never invokes models/OCI/network or modifies evaluationfiles. Inputs/outputs cannot overlap even when output is a parent of bundle/evaluation or symlink path; no overwrite.
Add broad meaningful table-driven raw fixture regressions for the above plus actual valid approve and requestchanges, diagnostics, timeoutnull, supersession, corruptbindings, clock/cutoff, missing human/cost, deterministic outputs. Run complete test_review_round_weekly_report and compileall changed module. Keep frozen data schema/read-only CLI, no Rust edits, no newframework/dependencies, preserve useful escaped drilldowns. Report actual tests/limits including core-helper integration pending if applicable.
